(2) agents/coordinator.md 'Dynamic dispatch' requires review_required on a claim-relevant producer, and AGENTS.md 'Review architecture' defines claim-changing as able to 'move a hypothesis status, close a lane, or support a headline claim'. The correction does none of these; it narrows. (3) Its content is already the output of a tier-valid rule-12 review: it is the cure the reviewer named in J2 O-1, adopted by DEC-20260930-8553d4 CU-5 and DEC-20260930-6f1d85 NA-1. (5) The hold release is pre-declared: R-HOLD-N2 runs 'until the successor correction (CU-5) decides them', and DEC-20260930-6f1d85 NA-1 states 'its acceptance releases R-HOLD-N2'. The release loses no protection, because the correction carries the prohibition forward as its own content (fa2cf0 CC-5). BOUNDS that keep this answer true, written into the cards: the correction may not state that a DISSENT is lifted, answered or superseded (CC-6); it may not be cited as an adopted closure ground until CU-7 has reviewed it and a composition under plan+A01 adopts; and if it asserts anything beyond the three NA-1 statements, it is not archived (7166be AR-6) and an independent review becomes required before it can be official.
